Calculator — A four-function calculator that reads expressions and handles bad input gracefully.
Number Guessing Game — The computer picks a secret number; you hunt it down with higher/lower hints.
Digital Clock — A live console clock that redraws itself every second.
Tic-Tac-Toe — Two players, one 3×3 grid — the first project on the Tic-Tac-Toe path.
Unit Converter — Convert length, weight, and temperature between metric and imperial units.
To-Do List App — Add, list, complete, and delete tasks — saved to a file so they survive restarts.
BMI Calculator — Compute Body Mass Index from height and weight, with a health category.
Student Grade System — Record scores for a class, compute averages, and assign letter grades.
Currency Converter — Convert between world currencies using a built-in table of exchange rates.
Rock Paper Scissors Game — Face the computer in the classic hand game, with a running score.
Calendar Generator — Print a correctly aligned calendar for any month and year.
Age Calculator — Enter a birth date and get an exact age in years, months, and days.
Password Strength Checker — Type a password and get an instant strength rating with reasons.
Quiz Game — A multiple-choice quiz that asks questions, checks answers, and grades you.
Temperature Logger — Record daily temperatures to a file and report trends and extremes.
File Encryptor/Decryptor — Scramble any file with a key so it can't be read — then unscramble it.
Stopwatch — Start, stop, lap, and reset — precise timing down to milliseconds.
ATM Simulation — PIN login, balance checks, deposits, and withdrawals with safety limits.
Leap Year Checker — The deceptively tricky rules for whether a year has 366 days.
Prime Number Finder — Test numbers for primality and generate every prime up to a limit.
Contact Management — A digital address book with add, search, edit, delete — and real persistence.
Bank Management System — Multiple account types, deposits, transfers, and interest — a mini banking core.
Simple Chat App (Console) — Two terminals on one network, sending messages to each other in real time.
Library Management System — Track books, members, loans, and overdue fines like a real small library.
Expense Tracker — Log spending by category and see where the money actually goes.
Snake Game — The legendary snake: eat, grow, and don't bite yourself.
Hangman Game — Guess the hidden word letter by letter before the drawing completes.
Simple Voting System — Register voters, cast one ballot each, and tally a tamper-resistant result.
Address Book — A searchable, sortable directory of people and their details.
Inventory Management — Track stock levels, flag low items, and value the whole warehouse.
Sudoku Solver — Feed it any Sudoku puzzle; backtracking finds the solution in milliseconds.
Railway Reservation System — Book train seats, manage waitlists, and cancel with automatic promotion.
File Compression Tool — Shrink text files with a real Huffman encoder — and restore them losslessly.
Parking Lot Management — Check vehicles in and out, assign spots, and bill by the hour.
Mini Shell — Your own tiny command shell: run programs, chain them with pipes.
Chess Clock — Two countdown clocks, one button — flag fall decides the game.
Tic-Tac-Toe with AI — The beginner board grows a brain: an AI that can never lose.
Music Playlist Manager — Build playlists on a hand-rolled linked list: next, previous, shuffle, repeat.
Resume Builder (text-based) — Answer questions, get a cleanly formatted resume as a text file.
Budget Calculator — Split a monthly income across needs, wants, and savings — and see the gaps.
Text Editor — A real terminal editor: open files, type, move, search, save — like kilo or nano.
Web Crawler — Start from one page, follow every link, and map a slice of the web.
Multiplayer Tic-Tac-Toe — The Tic-Tac-Toe path finale: two players, two computers, one network.
mini Compiler for C++ — Compile a tiny language of your own design: source in, meaning out.
Memory Management — Write your own allocator: a pool that hands out memory and takes it back.
File Search Engine — Index every text file in a folder, then search it like Google — instantly.
Graph Visualizer using STL — Build graphs, run BFS/DFS/Dijkstra, and watch traversals step by step.
E-commerce Backend — Products, carts, orders, and payments — the engine behind an online shop.
Game Engine (Basic 2D) — A small 2D engine: sprites, input, physics, collision — then a game on top.
Network Packet Sniffer — Capture live traffic and decode Ethernet, IP, and TCP headers by hand.
Chat Application TCP/UDP — A multi-user chat server with rooms — built on TCP, compared with UDP.
Image Editor (CLI version) — Load a PPM image and apply real filters: greyscale, blur, edge detection.
Bank Loan Approval System — Score loan applications against layered rules — and explain every decision.
Code Auto-formatter — Feed it messy C++ and get consistently indented, styled code back.
Hospital Management — Patients, doctors, appointments, and an emergency queue that jumps the line.
Credit Card Fraud Detection — Scan transaction streams and flag the ones that smell wrong — with reasons.
Student Portal System — Logins, roles, grades, and courses — the system behind a school portal.
Virtual File System — A filesystem inside a file: directories, files, and blocks you manage yourself.
Compiler Analyzer — Go beyond parsing: catch undeclared variables and type errors like a real compiler.
GUI-based Inventory — The inventory system grows a window: tables, forms, and live search.
